items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: And Doc Souchon was there. ... Doc Souchon made the presentation.

ctx.x: When I first heard you, almost one of the very first times anyway, which was some kind of deal up at Audubon Park and you had Harry and Tom Brown.

Well, I had a good band, yeah. None of us went in the Union at that time. That band later on went in the Union because they made some good tapes. Period. But the thing was I was playing, it was a parade first and it was a benefit baseball game, Burlesque, and we were running a jazz program in with it. And Doc Souchon was there. And I thought it was a good time to give Tom Brown a little recognition. So we gave him a little trophy and we figured, I wanted to put, Tom introduced jazz, you know, but we figured…
So anyway we had an inscribed Pioneer of Jazz in Chicago or something.
